$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. A release entry read section by section instead of one note above every tile. Zafar, 17 Sep 2026: "topic > icons, topic > icons. not all topics first and then all icons after that", then "categorize them, not just text > icons. titles, etc.", then "redrawns deserve to be a separate topic, not within a topic and each subtitle must carry shareable link like the main titles". So new drawings are filed under shelf sections (title, text, `names`), announcements with nothing to tile are sections of their own, and every redraw sits under one `Redrawn` section whose `sections` are shelves again (title, text, `redraws`). Titles are the shelves as the category rail names them. pipeline/build-history.mjs gives every section an `anchor` (v<version>-<title>, and v<version>-<parent>-<title> one level down) that the site prints as a link, keeps only the drawings the entry actually carries, and appends anything no section claims in a last untitled group, reported, so a stale list can never drop a drawing. Keyed by the version the work ships as, like lib/icon-release-order.json, so nothing needs re-keying at the tag. Numbers go in as {names} and {files}. Where a version has sections, every surface prints them in place of the note.

1.0.0.title: Four styles
1.0.0.text: Every name now comes in stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill: {files} SVGs across {names} names. The outlined duotone is called two-tone from this release, so an import of duotone that wants the old look changes to two-tone. Duotone is a new style with no outline, a grey body with the part that matters in black, drawn icon by icon.

1.0.0.title: People
1.0.0.text: A new shelf for the boy, the girl, a baby with a curl, one with a bow, and both babies again with a pacifier.

1.0.0.title: Layout
1.0.0.text: The panels gain their close, open and dashed forms on every side, three split layouts and a table.

1.0.0.title: Devices
1.0.0.text: The phone takes call, incoming, outgoing, missed and forwarded. The tablet takes its upright form and the phone's eight signs, a laptop arrives, and the tablet and the laptop each sit beside a phone.

1.0.0.title: Finance
1.0.0.text: Two banknotes carry a check, minus, plus and x.

1.0.0.title: Time
1.0.0.text: The alarm clock takes a check, plus and minus, beside a stopwatch and its reset.

1.0.0.title: Transport
1.0.0.text: A rocket climbs on its flame, trails speed lines and stands upright.

1.0.0.title: Pointers
1.0.0.text: A closed hand and an open hand join the pointer.

1.0.0.title: Arrows
1.0.0.text: The big arrows point four ways.

1.0.0.title: Text
1.0.0.text: The heading comes with its six levels.

1.0.0.title: Redrawn
1.0.0.text: Drawings that already shipped and were drawn again, each shown before and after.

sections.title: Layout
sections.text: The four dashed close panels sit their grey under the frame's round corners, and the grid fills keep 2 units clear of their edges.

sections.title: Devices
sections.text: In two-tone scan-eye greys its frame, and scan-search's handle starts on its ring.

sections.title: Finance
sections.text: The coins sit on rounder faces with 2 units between every coin.

sections.title: Pointers
sections.text: The pointer is drawn again in all four directions.

sections.title: Files
sections.text: The file fills cut their folded corner clear of the edge.

sections.title: Charts
sections.text: In two-tone the charts grey their axes and keep the data in black.

sections.title: Media
sections.text: The gallery frames take a tighter radius, and play is smaller.

sections.title: Shapes
sections.text: In two-tone circle-progress-play greys the part still to play.

sections.title: Web
sections.text: In two-tone globe-off greys its far side.
